description: Get your account details including current plan tier, monthly credit limits, and current usage. Response includes tier, limits (monthly_requests, overage_enabled, search_results, history_days), and usage (monthly_requests_used, monthly_requests_remaining, credit_balance for pay-per-use accounts). Also returns scheduled_tier and scheduled_change_at if a plan change is pending.
name: get_account
